raw_audio_provenance_and_alignment_priva.format: 44.1 kHz, 2-channel wav; channels are the same talker lateralised (ITD 0.70 ms, opposite ILD for target vs masker); mono = L/R mean (as the official derivative envelopes)
raw_audio_provenance_and_alignment_priva.identity: per trial: target = events.stim_file of the targetonset row; masker = stim_file of the maskeronset row inside the trial (inventory.json sha256 a7c7b8e9...)
raw_audio_provenance_and_alignment_priva.onset_alignment: target wav sample 0 = targetonset; masker wav sample 0 = maskeronset. Verified on 8 streams (2 NH + 2 HI fit-role trials) against official derivative envelopes (t re trial onset; masker t_first == masker_onset_rel_s): best lag -3.9 ms in all 8 (2 samples at 512 Hz, crude envelope), r at lag 0 = 0.71-0.85; wav length = trial duration within 12 ms (GATE345_RESULTS.json gate3_alignment)
raw_audio_provenance_and_alignment_priva.woa_vs_plain: HI listeners heard CamEQ-equalised 'stimuli' files; 'woa' = same speech without CamEQ (mono corr woa vs CamEQ 0.64-0.82). PROPOSED: HI -> woa, NH -> plain (project convention auditory_c3/features_dtu.py; same audio identity as the envelopes used by the core methods).

channels_reference_units_mapping_file: CHANNEL_CONTRACT.json: 64 BioSemi scalp channels in recorded order == MindMix ch_names (case-folded, same order); EXG1-8/Status excluded; recorded CMS reference kept (PROPOSED); z-score per window makes units immaterial; no spatial embedding at the pinned commit.
preprocessing_and_input_access: Paper App. A.2: EEG 1-40 Hz zero-phase Butterworth (PROPOSED scipy butter(N=4)+sosfiltfilt) on the continuous run, resample 512->200 Hz (resample_poly 25/64), 2 s windows (400 samples -> [64,2,200]), per-window per-channel z-score. Audio: wav -> mono -> 16 kHz (resample_poly 160/441) -> 2 s (32000 samples) -> divided by peak |x|. Windows only inside the project's physical 5 s two-talker segments (load_dtu geometry; segment start >= masker onset + 1.7 s), roles fit/es/test as frozen.py/readout.py. Training uses fit-role windows of the unit's training people (target_audio = attended stream); the masker audio is never used by the official training loss.
scorer_formula: s(x|t) = exp(logit_scale) * cos(fused_eeg(eeg,t), aligned_audio(eeg,x)) from the official MultimodalRealModel.forward_contrastive (eval mode); per-sample row diagonal (no in-batch softmax). Margin for physical candidates (c1,c2): m(c1,c2) = 1/2[(s(c1|c1) - s(c2|c1)) - (s(c2|c2) - s(c1|c2))] using two official calls (c1 in the target slot, then c2). Antisymmetric by construction; decision c1 iff m>0, tie 0.5.
candidate_swap_check: PASS: max|m(c1,c2)+m(c2,c1)| = 0.0 on synthetic (6) and real training-side (16) windows. Official scorer: prediction 'slot 1 wins' in BOTH orders for 100% of synthetic-noise and 100% of real windows (privileged target slot).
batch_invariance_check: PASS: |m(batch of 1) - m(full batch)| <= 2.9e-6, permutation 0.0, adding unrelated samples 0.0, 0 decision flips. Official scorer: batch size 1 always ties (pA=pB=1 -> pred 0); pA changes by up to 0.123 when unrelated samples are added.
true_label_hidden_until_evaluation_check: The scorer takes (eeg, c1, c2) only; the attended identity enters only when evaluating sign(m) after scoring; each candidate occupies the target slot once. Scoring must run in eval mode (train-mode dropout/drop_path/SpecAugment changed m by up to 0.73).
native_subwindow_geometry: PROPOSED: two non-overlapping 2 s sub-windows at +0.5 s and +2.5 s of each 5 s physical segment; segment margin = mean of the two sub-window margins; then the original 20 s mean-score (4 consecutive segments), training-side tau, double order (readout.attention). No offset search.
common_query_manifest_reason: not built in the readiness check; must be the core3 attention Q (frozen.py cs segments, role test, test people) and hashed before scoring
valid_coverage_rule_frozen_before_scores: PROPOSED: every common-Q 5 s segment is covered (both sub-windows lie inside the segment; segment start >= masker onset + 1.7 s so masker audio exists; target wav length = trial length); any segment lacking audio is excluded by geometry only and all core3 recomputed on the same Q.

training_recipe.source: README fine-tune table / public CLI = pinned code defaults
training_recipe.optimizer: AdamW(all model.parameters(), betas (0.9,0.95), eps 1e-8); no grad clipping; params without grad (classifier) are skipped
training_recipe.scheduler: LinearLR warmup 3 epochs from 1e-6 to 1e-5, then CosineAnnealingLR T_max 47, eta_min 1e-7; stepped once per epoch (per-epoch LR values in GATE345_RESULTS.json official_lr_per_epoch: 1e-6, 4e-6, 7e-6, 1e-5, ... 1.11e-7)
training_recipe.loss: ClipLoss(fused_eeg, aligned_audio) with in-batch negatives, learnable logit_scale (init ln(1/0.07)); negative_audio unused in training
training_recipe.regularisation: drop_path 0.1 (EEG), CALRA dropout 0.1, wav2vec2 config dropout/SpecAugment in train mode
training_recipe.loop: official trainer.setup_optimizer + train_epoch + update_learning_rate for 50 epochs (trainer.train() not used because its per-epoch evaluation is the non-blind scorer on the evaluated fold and it early-stops on that fold)
training_recipe.data_loader: PROPOSED: person-homogeneous batches of 32 (paper A.3: Stage-3 batches from the same subject across trials; the code's per-subject loop implies it), batch order shuffled with seed 3401, num_workers 0, last partial batch kept
training_recipe.precision: fp32 (no AMP in the official code)

checkpoint_selection_rule: fixed final epoch 50. Reason: the code selects on the evaluated fold itself (max accuracy over epochs, early stopping patience 20 on its F1) and the paper's rule ('until convergence on the validation set') is not specified enough to reuse; contract fallback final50.
readout_solver: not applicable (route A: end-to-end Stage 3 + blind margin; tau of the 20 s mean-score fitted on training-side windows only, as readout.attention)
author_protocol_differences: Paper/code protocol is within-subject (paper: random 70/10/20 windows, 5 folds; code: per-subject KFold on all windows) on DTU18 (zenodo 1199011) with 2 s window accuracy; here pooled person-held-out DTU44, 2 content x 5 person folds, 20 s mean-score decisions.

Official AAD scorer (pred = batch-softmax pA > pB with the true stream always in the target slot) replaced by the order-symmetrised per-sample margin; the official scorer selects slot 1 in both orders for 100% of noise inputs, so the published accuracies are not blind two-candidate accuracies.
Checkpoint selection: final50 instead of the code's best-on-evaluated-fold / early stopping.
Recipe from README/CLI (batch 32, wd 0.01, warmup 3); paper A.3 text says batch 64, wd 0.05, 10-epoch warmup; Table A2 says wd 0.01, warmup 3. Not run as a second recipe.
Paper Sec. 3 eq. (1) describes a 10-20 spatial embedding; the pinned code forces pos_embed=None and the released checkpoint has no pos_embed, so no spatial embedding is used (code and weights agree).

wav2vec2 positional-conv weight-norm tensors loaded by a pure key rename (weight_g/weight_v -> parametrizations.weight.original0/1); the official name-based loader silently leaves them at facebook/wav2vec2-base values under torch>=2.1.
clip_loss.logit_scale is not in the checkpoint and starts at ln(1/0.07).
Training pairs are two-talker fit windows with the attended stream as target_audio; single-talker trials not used (PROPOSED).
HI candidates use 'woa' (no CamEQ) audio although HI listeners heard CamEQ audio (PROPOSED, project convention).
Reference: recorded CMS kept; the authors' DTU18 reference/preprocessing source is not documented.
Butterworth order ambiguity ('4th-order' band-pass): PROPOSED scipy N=4.
Candidate audio is visible at test (candidate-matching setting), as for every AAD method using the two streams; not an EEG-only result.
Downstream seed 3401 (code default 42); one released checkpoint, one seed.

readiness_disclosures.objective_shortcut: With the released weights (eval mode, 16 training-side windows), the official Stage-3 ClipLoss is 0.0087 with the attended stream, 0.0049 with the IGNORED stream as target, 0.0087 with Gaussian-noise EEG, in-batch top-1 = 1.0 in all three; without CALRA (projections only) it is 3.26 with top-1 0.0625 (chance 1/16). The positive pair shares CALRA(eeg_i, a_i), so the objective is met without EEG-audio correspondence. On a real batch of 4 the training loss was 3.7e-4 (official loader epoch: 2.4e-5).
readiness_disclosures.eeg_sensitivity_at_release: blind margins with real vs noise EEG: r = 0.997, sign agreement 100%, mean |diff| 0.018 vs mean |m| 0.26 (DIAG_EEG_SENSITIVITY.json). At release the blind score is driven by the candidate audio; whether 50 epochs of the official recipe change this is unknown. No accuracy was computed.
readiness_disclosures.route_effect: none: the route is fixed by the pre-registered engineering gates and may not be chosen on expected scores; these facts must be reported with the external result.
